clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, Razzle Sprysprocket works to recover gnomish machinery. He tinkers with Ozzie Togglevolt and seeks lost parts scattered through the snowy hills.

After Gnomeregan's fall, Razzle found refuge in Dun Morogh and set up his workshop in Kharanos. He has a gift for delicate mechanical parts and works beside fellow engineer Ozzie Togglevolt. Together, they recover gyro-mechanisms and cog assemblies lost or scavenged during the flight from their irradiated homeland.

Wild beasts roam Dun Morogh's frozen ridges, and local Frostmane trolls raid the area. These dangers keep Razzle's work from being safe. Still, he labors to keep gnomish contraptions working and recover the lost wonders of Gnomeregan.
